reason: A reversible DeepSeek Harness UI theme plugin that applies Song-inspired light and dark palettes, typography preferences, and related visual styling.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可切换且可移除的宋韵风格浅色与深色界面主题。
summaries.en: Provides a reversible Song-inspired light and dark visual theme for DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Overrides DeepSeek Harness light and dark theme tokens
Changes visible colors, typography, focus outlines, and selection styling
Supports reversible theme-layer installation and removal
